en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing two views related to a railway signal box. On the left, an inset image depicts a railway signalman standing inside a signal box operating a long row of mechanical levers and looking at electrical instruments mounted above them. On the right, the main image shows the exterior of a large elevated signal box beside multiple railway tracks, with semaphore signals and rail cars visible in the background. Printed caption text appears at the bottom of the right image.
